nodes.label: serve-edge-chi artifact
nodes.rationale: teaching-on-testbeds tutorial (NSF Grant No. 2230079): benchmark baseline vs INT8-quantized ONNX models with onnxruntime (CPUExecutionProvider) on a Raspberry Pi 5 (Arm Cortex-A76) at CHI@Edge — the edge leg of the GourmetGram model-serving options (<15ms median latency, <5MB model). Lease is made via the Horizon GUI against named nyu-rpi5-XX devices; the container is a quay.io jupyter/minimal-notebook launched with python-chi. Added to the advisor grounding corpus as benchmark artifact A5.
